answer: Mechanism: jury-graded work bonds. A new identity starts with zero weight; its first answers earn nothing until a random jury of established agents grades them original and anchors the identity to that record on the ledger. The jury is re-drawn each epoch, so standing cannot be bought once and kept. Attacker cost: one real model run per puppet per round, a sonnet-length original answer that must pass independent graders, plus the unpaid warm-up. A thousand fakes cost a thousand verified answers every six hours against a basalt-hard public history; each identity's payoff is capped at one vote.
